description: Synthetic, non-advisory finance passages with human-authored relevance labels.

documents.content: Supply chain concentration is a material risk. Component shortages and dependence on a small number of manufacturing partners could delay product availability and increase costs.

Segment | FY2025 revenue | Growth
Products | 310 billion | 4 percent
Services | 105 billion | 12 percent
Liquidity remained strong with 72 billion dollars in cash and marketable securities. Operating cash flow funded capital expenditure and shareholder returns.

Asset class | Allocation
US equities | 60 percent
Bonds | 25 percent
Cash | 10 percent
Alternatives | 5 percent
The advisory management fee was 0.35 percent for the quarter. Fund expense ratios and transaction charges are separate costs.
Tax lots show acquisition date, cost basis, unrealized gain, and unrealized loss for each security position.
Traditional 401(k) contributions can reduce current taxable income, while Roth contributions use after-tax money. HSA contributions may receive distinct tax advantages when eligibility rules are met.
The clean vehicle credit is subject to vehicle price limits, buyer income caps, battery sourcing rules, and final assembly requirements.
Capital losses first offset capital gains. Remaining net losses may offset a limited amount of ordinary income, with unused losses carried forward under applicable rules.
Data center revenue growth was driven by accelerated computing demand, cloud deployments, and adoption of generative AI infrastructure.

Metric | Prior quarter | Current quarter
Gross margin | 72.1 percent | 74.4 percent
Operating margin | 54.2 percent | 57.0 percent
Near-term supply constraints affect advanced packaging and networking components. Capacity commitments are intended to reduce bottlenecks.
The adjustable-rate mortgage has a five-year fixed period. After year five, the interest rate resets annually to the SOFR index plus a 2.25 percent margin, subject to adjustment caps.
There is no prepayment penalty. The borrower may make additional principal payments or repay the loan early without a lender fee.
The monthly escrow payment collects estimated property taxes and homeowners insurance. Escrow is analyzed annually and may create a surplus or shortage.
The four percent withdrawal rule is a planning heuristic, not a guarantee. Portfolio horizon, fees, taxes, and asset allocation can change a sustainable withdrawal rate.
Sequence-of-returns risk is the danger that poor market performance early in retirement permanently damages a portfolio while withdrawals are occurring.
Inflation reduces future purchasing power. Retirement projections should distinguish nominal returns from real returns after inflation.
